title: Vertiv Holdings Co. (VRT): Stage 4 Stop Breach Triggers Immediate Exit Despite AI Compounder Fundamentals
archetype: AI Data Center Power & Liquid Cooling Compounder
primer: Vertiv (VRT) earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS on 23.93% ROIC and 25.2% Q3 margins. Still, Pass 1 flagged 4.2% capex, $3.29B inventory, and $1.45B UIG deal plus up to $1.15B earnout risk. On November 20, VRT fell 10.14% to $166.24, breaking our $185.16 stop in Stage 4. New capital is REJECTED (TIER_0), and all 23 Schwab shares are EXIT_IMMEDIATELY into Cash.
holding_rationale: The close at $166.24 sits 10.22% below our $185.16 hard stop. Selling hit 1.49x average volume in a Stage 4 drop. US equities also sit in a Downtrend with zero open VRT options. Our rule mandates an immediate full exit of all 23 shares. Move the $3,823.52 proceeds into 100% Cash and do not average down.

holding_alerts.trigger: Next session market/limit execution following November 20 close ($166.24 <= $185.16 breached stop)
holding_alerts.instruction: EXIT_IMMEDIATELY: sell all 23.0 Charles Schwab shares and move 100% of proceeds (~$3,823.52) into USD Cash / Treasury Bills.

holding_alerts.trigger: Any dead-cat bounce toward the broken $185.16–$193.79 shelf during liquidation
holding_alerts.instruction: Complete full 23-share exit into strength; never cancel exit orders or lower the stop on a Stage 4 breakdown.

holding_alerts.trigger: Post-exit re-entry watch: multi-week Stage 1 base above $147.82–$155.09 followed by Stage 2 weekly reclaim above 10W EMA ($213.55) and 50D SMA ($223.02) on >1.5x volume
holding_alerts.instruction: Keep zero shares until Stage 1 base and Stage 2 breakout align with an improving US market regime.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Proceeds from immediate exit of all 23.0 Charles Schwab VRT shares (~$3,823.52 at $166.24 close) plus marginal USD cash

destinations.recommendation: Retain 100% in USD Cash / Treasury Bills
destinations.rationale: The US equity market sits in a confirmed Downtrend (38.8% above 50-DMA, 10 distribution days, only 3 of 11 sectors above 50-DMA) and VRT is in Stage 4 below its breached $185.16 stop; cash protects capital and optionality.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit equities only after US breadth recovers above 50-DMA and VRT completes a multi-week Stage 1 base and Stage 2 reclaim.

destinations.recommendation: Keep Stage 2 shortlist leader LLY on bench at 0% allocation today
destinations.rationale: LLY ($1,347.11 close, STAGE_2, $1,282.61–$1,321.67 support band, $1,158.67 stop) remains a top-ranked shortlist compounder, but 0% is deployed during a 10-distribution-day US Downtrend.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only if US market regime exits Downtrend and LLY tests its $1,282.61–$1,321.67 support band.

destinations.recommendation: Keep electrical/thermal peer ETN on watchlist at 0% allocation today
destinations.rationale: Eaton ($311.33 close, 19.02x forward P/E, $475.22 Finviz consensus target) offers diversified data-center power and Boyd Thermal exposure, yet sits in STAGE_4 (snapshot Stop $383.84 > CMP, leaving active asymmetry N/A) and receives 0% capital.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit only after ETN forms a Stage 1 base and reclaims Stage 2 in an improving US market.
